.. py:class:: Process(name)


   A class representing a process that transforms input flows into output flows.

   .. attribute:: name

      The name of the process.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: description

      A description of the process.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: tags

      A list of tags associated with the process.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: WS

      A list of waste streams associated with the process.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: inputs

      A list of input flows to the process.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: outputs

      A list of output flows from the process.

      :type: list

   .. attribute:: parameters

      A list of parameters associated with the process.

      :type: list

   .. py:method:: print_transfer_coefficients()

      Prints the transfer coefficients of the process in a nice table


   .. py:method:: print_flows()

      Prints the input and output flows of the process in a nice table


   .. py:method:: print_table()


   .. py:method:: add_transfer_coefficient(flow_input, flow_output, transfer_coefficient, uncertainty)

      Adds a transfer coefficient to the process.

      :param input: The input flow.
      :type input: str
      :param output: The output flow.
      :type output: str
      :param transfer_coefficient: The transfer coefficient.
      :type transfer_coefficient: float
      :param uncertainty: The uncertainty of the transfer coefficient.
      :type uncertainty: float


   .. py:method:: add_to_model(model)


   .. py:method:: add_input(flow)

      Adds an input flow to the process.

      :param flow: The input flow to add.
      :type flow: Flow


   .. py:method:: add_output(flow)

      Adds an output flow to the process.

      :param flow: The output flow to add.
      :type flow: Flow


   .. py:method:: remove_input(flow)

      Removes an input flow from the process.

      :param flow: The input flow to remove.
      :type flow: Flow


   .. py:method:: remove_output(flow)

      Removes an output flow from the process.

      :param flow: The output flow to remove.
      :type flow: Flow


   .. py:method:: clear_inputs()

      Clears all input flows from the process.


   .. py:method:: clear_outputs()

      Clears all output flows from the process.


   .. py:method:: get_total_input_flow()

      Calculates the total input flow to the process.

      :returns: The total input flow to the process.


   .. py:method:: get_total_output_flow()

      Calculates the total output flow from the process.

      :returns: The total output flow from the process.


   .. py:method:: add_transform_flow(flow, function)

      Transforms an input flow and adds the resulting output flow to the process.

      :param flow: The input flow to transform.
      :type flow: Flow
      :param function: The function to use for the transformation.
      :type function: function


   .. py:method:: has_input(flow)

      Checks if an input flow is associated with the process.

      :param flow: The input flow to check.
      :type flow: Flow

      :returns: True if the input flow is associated with the process, False otherwise.


   .. py:method:: has_output(flow)

      Checks if an output flow is associated with the process.

      :param flow: The output flow to check.
      :type flow: Flow

      :returns: True if the output flow is associated with the process, False otherwise.


   .. py:method:: has_tag(tag)

      Checks if a tag is associated with the process.

      :param tag: The tag to check.
      :type tag: str

      :returns: True if the tag is associated with the process, False otherwise.


   .. py:method:: add_parameter(parameter)

      Adds a parameter to the process.

      :param parameter: The parameter to add.


   .. py:method:: remove_parameter(parameter)

      Removes a parameter from the process.

      :param parameter: The parameter to remove.


   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Converts the process to a dictionary.

      :returns: A dictionary representation of the process.


   .. py:method:: make_flowchart()

      Creates an isolated process flow diagram for
      the process, showing only the direct inputs and outputs.
      This is only reversing the syntax really,
      it uses the function from the visualisation module.


   .. py:method:: output_table()

      Creates a table of the output flows of the process.

      :returns: A table of the output flows of the process.


   .. py:method:: input_table()

      Creates a table of the input flows of the process.

      :returns: A table of the input flows of the process.



.. py:class:: Model(name)


   The Model class is the main class of the FutuRuM package.

   The Model class contains all of the other classes,          and is the main object that is used to build a model.

   .. attribute:: name

      The name of the model.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: type

      The type of the model. This is always 'model'.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: parameters

      A dictionary of the parameters in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: scenarios

      A dictionary of the scenarios in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: processes

      A dictionary of the processes in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: flows

      A dictionary of the flows in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: elements

      A dictionary of the elements in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: compounds

      A dictionary of the compounds in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: materials

      A dictionary of the materials in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: components

      A dictionary of the components in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: products

      A dictionary of the products in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: matter

      A dictionary of all matter in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: inputs

      A dictionary of the inputs to the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: outputs

      A dictionary of the outputs from the model.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: transfer_coefficients

      A dictionary of the transfer coefficients in the model.

      :type: dict

   .. method:: add_parameter

      

   .. method:: get_parameter

      

   .. method:: add_scenario

      

   .. method:: get_scenario

      

   .. method:: add_process

   .. method:: add_compound

      

   .. method:: get_compound

      

   .. method:: add_material

      

   .. method:: get_material

      

   .. method:: add_component

      

   .. method:: get_component

      

   .. method:: add_product

      

   .. method:: get_product

      

   .. method:: add_input

      

   .. method:: get_input

      

   .. method:: add_output

   Dependencies:
       - pandas
       - json
       - prettytable
       - random


   .. py:method:: export_model()

      Exports the model as a json or pickle file


   .. py:method:: calculate_flows()

      calculates the flows amounts iteratively in the model
      using the transfer coefficients, the composition of the flows
      and the input flows to the model


   .. py:method:: make_flowchart_model()

      Create a flowchart for the whole model, showing all processes and their inputs and outputs


   .. py:method:: make_network()

      Create a network of the processes in the model.
      Uses the networkx package to make a directed graph of the processes and flows in the model.


   .. py:method:: make_flowchart_processes()

      Create isolated flowcharts for each process in the model,              showing only the process and its direct inputs and outputs


   .. py:method:: get_transfer_coefficients()

      Returns a dictionary of all transfer coefficients in the model,              with keys in the format "ProcessName - TCName"


   .. py:method:: print_transfer_coefficients()

      Prints all of the transfer coefficients of the model in a nice table


   .. py:method:: print_flows_by_process()


   .. py:method:: print_matter()

      prints the matter objects in the model


   .. py:method:: print_matter_subclasses()

      prints the matter subclasses in the model


   .. py:method:: get_flows()


   .. py:method:: get_inputs()


   .. py:method:: get_outputs()


   .. py:method:: random_process()

      Get a random process from the model.

      :returns: The random process.
      :rtype: Process


   .. py:method:: random_flow()

      Get a random flow from the model.

      :returns: The random flow.
      :rtype: Flow


   .. py:method:: random_matter()

      Get a random matter object from the model.

      :returns: The random matter object.
      :rtype: Element, Compound, Material, Component                 or Product

   .. py:method:: to_dataframe()

      Convert the model objects to a dataframe.

      :returns: A dataframe representing the model objects.
      :rtype: pd.DataFrame


   .. py:method:: to_excel(filename)

      Write the model objects to an Excel file.

      :param filename: The name of the Excel file.
      :type filename: str


   .. py:method:: to_csv(filename)

      Write the model objects to a CSV file.

      :param filename: The name of the CSV file.

   .. attribute:: - symbol

      The symbol of the element.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: - atomic_number

      The atomic number of the element.

      :type: int

   .. attribute:: - atomic_mass

      The atomic mass of the element.

      :type: float

   .. py:method:: get_symbol(symbol)

      Checks if the composition is a dictionary or a             string and converts it to a dictionary if necessary.



   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Makes a dictionary of the element object.



   .. py:method:: to_series()

      Converts the matter object dict to a pandas series.



   .. py:method:: add_to_model(model)

      Adds the matter object to the model object.




.. py:class:: Compound(name, composition_molecular)


   Bases: :py:obj:`Matter`

   A subclass that represents a compound.
   .. attribute:: - formula

      The chemical formula of the compound.

   .. py:method:: print_formula()

      Prints the formula of the compound.



   .. py:method:: get_formula(composition_molecular)

      Checks if the composition is a dictionary             or a string and converts it to a dictionary if necessary.



   .. py:method:: formula_to_dict(formula)

      Converts a chemical formula string to a dictionary of element symbols and counts.
      :param formula: The chemical formula string.
      :type formula: str

      :returns: A dictionary of element symbols and counts.
      :rtype: dict


   .. py:method:: calculate_molecular_weight()

      calculates the molecular weight of the compound



   .. py:method:: calculate_molar_fractions()

      calculates the molar fractions of the compound

      :param molecular_weight: molecular weight of the compound
      :type molecular_weight: float

      :returns: **molar_fractions**
      :rtype: dict


   .. py:method:: calculate_mass_fractions()

      calculates the mass fractions of the compound

      :param molecular_weight: molecular weight of the compound
      :type molecular_weight: float

      :returns: **composition**
      :rtype: dict


   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Makes a dictionary of the compound object.



   .. py:method:: to_series()

      Converts the matter object dict to a pandas series.



   .. py:method:: add_to_model(model)

      Adds the matter object to the model object.




.. py:class:: Material(name, composition)


   Bases: :py:obj:`Matter`

   A subclass that represents a material made up of multiple composition.
   .. attribute:: - composition

      A dict of Component objects

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: - matter_type

      The type of matter, e.g. 'material'

      :type: str


.. py:class:: Component(name, composition)


   Bases: :py:obj:`Matter`

   A subclass that represents a component of a material.
   .. attribute:: - matter

      A matter object representing the matter of the component.

      :type: matter


.. py:class:: Product(name, composition)


   Bases: :py:obj:`Matter`

   A subclass that represents a product.
   .. attribute:: - composition ()

      A dictionary of matter objects              representing the composition of the product.


.. py:class:: Matter(name)


   A superclass that represents matter.
   .. attribute:: - name

      The name of the matter.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: - EC

      The EC number of the matter.

      :type: str

   .. attribute:: - composition

      The composition of the matter.

      :type: dict)(dict

   .. attribute:: - attributes_physchem

      A dictionary of physical/chemical attributes of the matter.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: - attributes_economic

      A dictionary of economic attributes of the matter.

      :type: dict

   .. attribute:: The nested composition dictionary should be of the following structure

      

   {
       name: {matter_type : string
                mass_fraction : float between 0 and 1
                uncertainty : float between 0 and 1},
       name: {matter_type : string
                   mass_fraction : float between 0 and 1
                   uncertainty : float between 0 and 1},

   }


   .. py:method:: __repr__()

      Return repr(self).


   .. py:method:: add_to_model(model)

      Adds the matter object to the model object.



   .. py:method:: to_dict()

      Makes a dictionary of the matter object.
      With the following structure:
      {
      'Name': str,
      'Tags': list,
      'Physical/chemical attributes': dict,
      'Economic attributes': dict,
      }



   .. py:method:: expand_composition()

      Expands the composition of the matter to include the composition of its components.



   .. py:method:: composition_expanded_to_json()

      Converts the expanded composition to a json string.



   .. py:method:: to_series()

      Converts the matter object dict to a pandas series.



   .. py:method:: add_tag(tag)

      Adds a tag to the matter object's tag list.



   .. py:method:: create_treemap()

      Creates a treemap of the matter object.
